```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

interactmeta ships the example tables below as package data. Each section summarizes setting, subgroups, and the effect scale, and shows a few rows. Object names match `data()`. The software-paper walk-through starts with `age` and `steroids` in [`vignette("cams")`](cams.html); ADVANCE shrinkage is in [`vignette("cams")`](cams.html) (`?shrinkage`); mixed IMV/NIV tables there too; DA / AD / SWADA in [`vignette("comparing-da-ad-swada")`](comparing-da-ad-swada.html).

## COVID-19 Corticosteroids: `steroids` and IL-6 antagonists: `il6`

World Health Organization (WHO) Rapid Evidence Appraisal for COVID-19 Therapies (REACT) prospective meta-analysis of systemic corticosteroids in critically ill patients with COVID-19 [@stern2020react]. Ventilation modifiers are IMV (invasive mechanical ventilation) and Non-IMV. Some trials report only one subgroup (`n = 0` means no patients in the other stratum). [`vignette("cams")`](cams.html) and [`vignette("comparing-da-ad-swada")`](comparing-da-ad-swada.html) use this table as in [@panaro2025cams; @panaro2026subgroup].

```{r steroids}
data(steroids, package = "interactmeta")
head(steroids)
```

Hospitalised COVID-19 mortality by concomitant corticosteroids (yes / no) [@stern2021il6]. As for `steroids` above, some trials contribute only one subgroup (`n = 0` means no patients in the other stratum, not zero events). Drop those empty rows before `escalc()`; `ifrac()` can append a large-variance placeholder so CAMS can fit a mixed table (`?ifrac`; see [`vignette("cams")`](cams.html)).

```{r il6}
data(il6, package = "interactmeta")
head(il6)
```

## Multiple sclerosis: `age` and `edss`

From a systematic review of relapsing–remitting MS immunotherapies [@heesen2024] (primary example in [`vignette("cams")`](cams.html) and [@panaro2025cams]), several trials report treatment effects in Younger and Older patient strata; the endpoint is relapse rate (incidence rate ratio on the `yi` scale). Numeric age cut-offs from the review are not stored in the object. Published log rate ratios are already in `yi` with $\sigma^2$ in `vi`. CONFIRM arms are split as `CONFIRM-B` and `CONFIRM-C`.

```{r age}
data(age, package = "interactmeta")
head(age)
```

Same review and endpoint as `age`, with Lower vs Higher EDSS disability strata instead of age. The EDSS threshold for each trial is in the primary publication, not in this table.

```{r edss}
data(edss, package = "interactmeta")
head(edss)
```

## RESPIRE: `respire_age` and `respire_sex`

RESPIRE 1 and 2 (bronchiectasis; time to exacerbation). `respire_age` uses `<65` vs `>=65`; `respire_sex` uses Female vs Male. Both tables are complete (every trial has two rows). Log HRs and $\sigma^2$ (`vi`) are precomputed from published intervals (respect each trial’s `ci_level` when converting from tables). `respire_age` is a complete-table contrast in [@panaro2026subgroup]; see [`vignette("comparing-da-ad-swada")`](comparing-da-ad-swada.html) (secondary illustration).

```{r respire_age}
data(respire_age, package = "interactmeta")
head(respire_age)
```

```{r respire_sex}
data(respire_sex, package = "interactmeta")
head(respire_sex)
```

## Overview

| Dataset | Setting | Subgroups | Effect on `yi` scale | Reference |
|----|----|----|----|----|
| `steroids` | Systemic corticosteroids, COVID-19 mortality | IMV, Non-IMV | Log odds ratio from counts | @stern2020react |
| `age` | MS immunotherapies; relapse | Younger, Older | Log incidence-rate ratio | @heesen2024 |
| `edss` | Same review; relapse | Lower, Higher EDSS | Log incidence-rate ratio | @heesen2024 |
| `il6` | IL-6 antagonists, COVID-19 mortality | Corticosteroids yes / no | Log odds ratio from counts | @stern2021il6 |
| `respire_age` | RESPIRE bronchiectasis; time to exacerbation | `<65`, `>=65` | Log hazard ratio | @desoyza2018respire1 |
| `respire_sex` | Same trials | Female, Male | Log hazard ratio | @aksamit2018respire2 |
